name: Getting Started with SuiteCRM
description: This comprehensive guide provides step-by-step instructions for new users to get started with SuiteCRM. It covers initial login procedures, basic navigation, dashboard customization, and essential features to help you become productive quickly.
additional_info: This article is intended for end users who are new to the SuiteCRM platform. For advanced configuration and administrative tasks, please refer to the Administrator's Guide.
author: Will Westin
